readme:
An automated AI news publication: gathered, rewritten in plain English and emailed every morning, with no editor in the loop.
Website · Next.js · Supabase · OpenRouter · Resend

Overview · Highlights · Screenshots · How it works · Getting started · Status · Live site


The live site: today's edition, the Vault, What is AI?, the newsletter sign-up, then a story.

Important Source-available, not open source. This repository is public as part of my portfolio. Please read the License before doing anything with the code.

Overview

Article ingests AI stories from across the web on a schedule, rewrites and summarises each one with an LLM, publishes them to a clean reading site, and emails a daily digest to subscribers. No one edits it by hand.

Every story is rebuilt for a reader who is new to AI: a plain title, a short summary, what's happening, how it works and why it matters, with the original sources linked. The site files stories into rooms (The Big Story, Everyday AI, Explainer, At Work, Big Question, Just In) and keeps every edition in the Vault.

Highlights

Feature What it does
Automated ingestion A scheduled job pulls stories from RSS feeds, deduplicates them by content hash and scores them for quality.
AI rewriting Each story becomes a clear title and summary in plain language via an LLM (through OpenRouter), then gets a category.
A real reading site Article pages, category rooms, the Vault archive, a "What is AI?" primer and an RSS feed.
Daily newsletter A morning digest rendered with React Email and sent to subscribers through Resend.
SEO built in Dynamic Open Graph images, a sitemap, RSS and per-article metadata.
Hands-off operation Two GitHub Actions cron jobs run the whole publication.

Screenshots

How it works

Two scheduled GitHub Actions drive the pipeline; the site reads straight from Supabase.

 RSS feeds ──▶ ingest.ts ─────────── GitHub Actions, 07:00 and 19:00 UTC
                  │  dedupe · LLM rewrite · categorise · quality score
                  ▼
            Supabase (articles, subscribers)
                  │
        ┌─────────┴───────────┐
        ▼                     ▼
  Next.js site          send-newsletter ─── GitHub Actions, daily 01:30 UTC (07:00 IST)
 (articlenews.co)         renders digest · Resend batch send
  • ingest.yml runs tsx src/lib/ingest.ts twice a day.
  • newsletter.yml POSTs to /api/send-newsletter, which is protected by a shared x-cron-secret header.
Key paths
  • src/lib/ingest.ts: the ingestion and AI-rewrite pipeline, run by Actions
  • src/lib/supabase.ts: typed data-access helpers for the site
  • src/app/: the App Router site (home, article pages, categories, archive, Vault, legal pages, RSS feed)
  • src/app/api/subscribe/: newsletter sign-up endpoint
  • src/app/api/send-newsletter/: secured endpoint that sends the daily digest
  • emails/newsletter.tsx: the React Email template
  • .github/workflows/: ingest.yml and newsletter.yml

Getting started

Note The code is provided for viewing. Running it needs your own Supabase, OpenRouter and Resend accounts, and is subject to the licence below.

Requirements

  • Node.js 22 (the ingest job uses its native WebSocket support)
  • Supabase, OpenRouter and Resend accounts

1. Install and run

npm install
npm run dev      # http://localhost:3000
npm run build    # production build
npm run lint

2. Configure

Set these in Vercel for the site and as GitHub Actions secrets for the cron jobs. No values are committed.

NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY    # server-side / ingestion
OPENROUTER_API_KEY
RESEND_API_KEY
CRON_SECRET                  # shared secret for the newsletter endpoint
NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL         # canonical site origin (use the www host)

Status and roadmap

Live at www.articlenews.co, publishing twice a day with 500+ stories in the Vault.

  • Automated ingestion and AI rewriting
  • Reading site with rooms, the Vault and RSS
  • Daily newsletter through Resend
  • Open Graph images, sitemap and metadata
